search.query: index=scoreboard ctf_id="$ctf_id$" user!=admin | stats max(BasePointsAwarded) as BasePoints max(SpeedBonusAwarded) as BonusPoints max(AdditionalBonusAwarded) as AdditionalBonus sum(Penalty) as Penalty by Team Number | eval Score=BasePoints+BonusPoints+AdditionalBonus-Penalty | eval Score=if(Score<0,0,Score) | rename Number as QNum | fields Team QNum Score | sort Team QNum | xyseries Team QNum Score | fillnull value=NA
